parts.text: {"units":[{"kind":"requirement","meaning":"Places the burden of proof on the employer to demonstrate that an employee has not worked the required 1,250 hours whenever the employer fails to maintain an accurate record of the employee's hours worked, including for FLSA-exempt executive, administrative, and professional staff.","quote":"In the event an employer does not maintain an accurate record of hours worked by an employee, including for employees who are exempt from FLSA's requirement that a record be kept of their hours worked (e.g., bona fide executive, administrative, and professional employees as defined in FLSA Regulations, 29 CFR part 541), the employer has the burden of showing that the employee has not worked the requisite hours.","scope_quotes":["(c)(3)"]}]}
